Subject: Commercial packaging options for BrightBridge VPC deployment

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We finished the technical review and are moving into commercial evaluation. A couple of questions that would help speed the procurement cycle on our side:

1) We're trying to understand the trade-offs between a seat-based seat+node bundle versus a purely node-based (capacity) pricing model for on-prem / VPC installs. Can you provide an apples-to-apples example for a 12-month term that covers: licensing, the platform fee, and premium support (24x7 oncall)?

2) BrightBridge runs a heavy inference footprint but prefers predictable amortized costs. Do you offer multi-year amortized discounts or upfront bulk discounts for node commitments? If so, what's your standard range?

3) We have a procurement constraint: capital spend must be < $300k in Y1 with the rest as Opex. Is there flexibility on invoicing (monthly vs. upfront with a credit schedule)?

Attached: BrightBridge_RFI_and_requirements.xlsx — contains sizing assumptions.

Appreciate a short matrix of options and a recommended path; we can then share with Finance and Procurement next week.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Director, AI Platform
BrightBridge Health
procurement@brightbridge.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Samir — thanks for the clear questions and the RFI. High level answers up front, then a compact matrix below. Looping Grace to help with commercial math and Sean for billing flexibility.

Short answers:
- We can support both seat+node bundles and pure node (capacity) models. Seat bundles include named operator seats + node capacity and are typically better for teams that need per-user access controls and training/ops licensing. Node-only is optimized for predictable token throughput pricing.
- Upfront bulk discounts are standard on 12–36 month commits; range is typically 10–30% depending on node count and support tier.
- Invoicing: we can do monthly consumption billing, upfront invoice with amortized credits across the term, or a hybrid (partial upfront + monthly).

Attached: draft_SOW_v1.docx — a starter SOW we can adjust for BrightBridge assumptions.

Compact proposal (example for your RFI sizing):

Option A — Seat bundle (recommended if you need named operator seats + prioritized SLAs)
- License: 25 operator seats + 6 production nodes (NVIDIA H100 equiv.)
- Platform fee: $75k/year (includes console, analytics, 90d retention)
- Premium support (24x7): $60k/year
- List price Y1: $750k (license + platform + support + first-year sizing)
- Typical discount band: 10–18% on list for 12-months; 18–25% for 24-months

Option B — Node-only (predictable capacity)
- License: 8 production nodes (scale-managed)
- Platform fee: $60k/year
- Premium support: $60k/year
- List price Y1: $620k
- Typical discount band: 12–22% on list depending on node commit

Option C — Staggered commit (mix of starter nodes + burst credits)
- Starter: 4 nodes + burst pool credits, lighter platform fee $42k/year
- Pilot credits: 3 months of reduced unit pricing to validate model
- Good if you want to keep Y1 capex low and ramp in Y2

Commercial levers we can use to hit your < $300k capex target: lower upfront node count + amortize platform fee and license across 24 months, or provide a one-time migration credit to offset initial invoice.

Next steps: Grace — can you populate a short spreadsheet with the net pricing for each option at discount thresholds (10%, 15%, 20%)? Sean — can you confirm amortization terms and whether we can split a 12-month invoice into an accepted capital/opex schedule for BrightBridge finance?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa / Grace — thanks for the clear options and the worksheet. A few decisions from our side after an internal review with Finance: 

- We're comfortable pursuing Option B (node-only) but need a tighter discount to make the numbers work: target net reduction of ~20% off the list price for a 12-month term with an option to extend to 24 months at a similar uplift.
- Capital constraint: we must keep initial invoice <= $300k. We prefer amortization across 24 months for the platform fee and license line items if you can send legal language for our finance team to accept.
- Pilot: we'd like a 90-day proof-of-concept with a credit equivalent to 10% of Y1 list to offset migration/setup costs.

Procurement contact: procurement@brightbridge.com — they will own contract redlines. Please provide a short SOW and proposed invoice schedule; I'll route to procurement and legal.

If you can move to 20% off list on Option B and include a one-time $45k migration credit, we can sign the MSA and start on a 90-day pilot by mid-December.

Thanks,
Samir Kapoor
Director, AI Platform
BrightBridge Health
